title: Join statistics omit right-side aliases when applying hints.

proposal_metadata.summary: Use both join inputs for side-specific hint aliases and derive the result alias union from relation identities.
review: Independent patch generated directly from pinned base; production worktrees unchanged.
validation_plan: Assert left/right/composite/absent row and byte hints target the intended statistics.
Cover nested joins, self-joins with duplicate aliases, and semi/anti joins whose output omits one side.
Verify a hint is consumed once and unrelated hints do not change a larger result estimate.
limits: The existing lineage suffix policy is preserved; this patch does not redesign hint syntax or alias naming.
Both input metadata objects must already exist at the metadata/statistics call sites, as in the existing flow.

verification_limitation: Source preparation only; compilation, native semantics and optimization evidence still required.
